transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I'm here because... I just don't care about anything anymore. I used to do things, you know? I had my art classes, board-game nights, hiking... I was even going to get back to playing on my soccer team. But now, I just don't care about any of it. I just sit in my room all day while everything kind of just slips away.
Can you tell me more about not caring anymore? Specifically, do you no longer enjoy things that used to make you happy, like your art classes or soccer?

Yeah, that's exactly it. I just don't get any joy out of them anymore. Like, I used to love painting and going to those art classes, and I was really looking forward to playing soccer again. But now... I don't know, the thought of doing any of it just feels pointless. I don't feel anything when I think about them. So I just stay in my room. It's like the feeling of wanting to do things is just gone.
Do you feel down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah, I do. Most days, actually. I just... I wake up and there's this heavy, hollow feeling right in my chest. It's there almost every day. It just feels like... like there's no future for me at all, you know? Nothing beyond the walls of my apartment. It's just this constant, heavy sadness.
Do you find yourself feeling guilty or blaming yourself for things more than usual, or feeling like you’re not good enough?

Yeah, I do. I... I feel like I'm just a burden to everyone. I keep replaying every little thing I did wrong, like in my marriage and with my friends. I just think about all my mistakes constantly. Honestly, part of me believes that people would just be safer and less burdened if I were gone. It just feels like I'm not good enough for anyone.
Have you experienced episodes of depression like this before, or is this the first time you've felt this way?

I mean, I've felt down before, but... not exactly like this. This time, it became really constant around the following summer. Like, it just never lifted after that. So it's been about... a year and four months now that it's been going on like this.
Before this current period of feeling down, have you ever had any other times in your life where you felt depressed for a period of at least a couple of weeks?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had bad days, sure, but... never anything that lasted for weeks on end like this. This is the first time it's been this bad for this long.
Have there ever been times when you felt unusually high, overly energetic, or extremely confident, even to the point where others might have noticed you were acting out of character?

No, I haven't ever felt like that. I don't really get... energetic or anything. I've always just been kind of normal, or, you know, feeling like I do now. But never unusually high or overly confident.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or have trouble sitting still, to the point that others might notice?

Yeah, actually, it's... it's kind of both. Some days I just can't sit still. I'll pace back and forth, like from the kitchen to the window, over and over until my legs actually ache. But then other times... it's the exact opposite. I move so slowly. Just doing something simple, like making a cup of coffee, it feels like I'm trying to lift wet cement. Everything just feels so heavy.
Have you ever experienced a period where you felt unusually upbeat, energized, or irritable for several days in a row, where it was a noticeable change from your usual mood?

No, I haven't. Like I said before, I don't really get energized or upbeat like that. I've never had a time where I felt unusually high or anything for days on end. It's just... not something that happens to me.
Can you clarify whether your current low mood has been continuous for the entire time since it started, or if there have been any significant breaks where you felt back to normal in between?

It's been continuous. Um, it really became constant around the following summer after it first started. Since then, there haven't been any breaks where I felt normal again. It's just been steady like this for about a year and four months now.
Have you noticed any periods, even brief ones, where your mood improved significantly for a few days or more during this time?

No, not really. Um, there haven't been any good days or improvements like that. Most of the time since this whole thing took over, it's... I haven't just been scared or confused by what's happening to me. I've been deeply depressed. I'm barely interested in anything anymore, and I honestly just feel like my life is already over. So, no, it hasn't lifted.
Have you experienced any brief periods, even just a day or two, where your mood improved enough that you felt at least somewhat like your usual self during this time?
No, not even for a day or two. Like I just said, there haven't been any breaks at all. It's just been a constant, heavy feeling the whole time. I haven't felt like my usual self in a very long time.
Have your symptoms made it hard for you to function normally, like going to work, taking care of tasks, or interacting with people?

Yes, it's... it's made everything really hard. I've actually stopped taking on any freelance art-education work completely. I just can't do it right now. And I've missed all my community events, and I stopped going to soccer. 

Honestly, I can't really take care of myself. I have a friend who has to keep checking in on me because I'm just... I'm not reliably eating, or showering, or even keeping myself safe on my own. I just can't function like I used to.

Before this current period of depression started, did you ever have another time in your life where you felt this depressed for at least two weeks, and was there a clear period of at least two months in between where you felt back to normal?

No, I don't think so. Um, I mean, I've had times in the past where I felt down, but nothing like this. This is... this is the first time it's been this bad, and it hasn't stopped since it started. So, no, there hasn't been a time like this before with a gap in between.
